messages:
anya: Quick ask — we saw a small spike in 502/504s on prod api-gateway around 10:12 UTC. Where are the best dashboards + trace views to grab sample traces and error buckets?
micah: Start with Grafana -> Observability -> "API Gateway Errors" dashboard. It has 502/504 heatmap and per-route panels. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/api-gateway-errors
samir: Also check Envoy metrics in Prometheus: `sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_timeouts_total[5m])) by (cluster)` and `sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_5xx[5m])) by (cluster)` — that separates upstream timeouts vs 5xx.
lee: If you want quick trace samples use Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/ — search service=api-gateway and op=proxy; filter by tag `http.status_code=502` to get real traces. Honeycomb is good for high-cardinality context: dataset=prod_requests.
anya: Thanks — do we have the per-route 502 alert and the dashboard panel id? need to decide alert tuning.
micah: Alert name is `Gateway5xxRate` under /alerting -> rules. Current threshold is 0.5% 5xx over 5m. Grafana panel id is panel=23 (top-right).
samir: For latency buckets try `increase(request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="1.0"}[5m])` to see spike in the <=1s bucket. Also grep Loki for the NGINX upstream errors: `{app="api-gateway"} |= "upstream timed out"`
lee: FYI deploy-bot posted a deploy at 10:08 which might correlate: `deploy-bot: Deploy api-gateway@release-2026.03.17`
micah: To pull specific Jaeger traces quickly you can curl the UI API, e.g.:
```
curl -G 'https://jaeger.redwood.internal/api/traces' \
  --data-urlencode 'service=api-gateway' \
  --data-urlencode 'start=1771002400000000' \
  --data-urlencode 'end=1771002600000000' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
anya: Can SRE bump the alert to 1% for the gateway for 10m while we validate? Current SLO for user-facing endpoints is 0.2% so we need to be careful.
samir: +1 to temporary bump if we add a runbook link to the alert. I can open a quick PR to change `for: 5m` -> `for: 10m` and add a note with trace ids. Pinging @sre-oncall.
devex-ops: Added a dashboard bookmark for the team: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123?orgId=1&view=panel&panelId=23
sre-bot: @sre-oncall notified: incident-checklist requested — please triage.
anya: Sounds good. Samir — can you attach 2-3 trace ids to the PR so oncall can inspect quickly?
samir: Will do, attaching ~3 Jaeger trace ids and a short note in the PR. Thanks!
micah: Nice — once PR merged let's revert the temporary threshold if nothing else pops up. :thumbsup:
